scripts.clean: rm -rf dist dist-test node_modules yarn.lock package-lock.json
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm run build && npm test
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-quick
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run build && npm run test && npm run repo-bump && npm run repo-tag && npm run repo-stage-publish
scripts.repo-stage-publish: aql vault exec --for=npm vxg:pub01 -- npm stage publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --access=public
scripts.repo-stage-publish-dry: aql vault exec --dry-run --for=npm vxg:pub01 -- npm stage publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --access=public --dry-run
scripts.repo-stage-list: aql vault exec --for=npm vxg:pub01 -- npm stage list
scripts.repo-stage-view: aql vault exec --for=npm vxg:pub01 -- npm stage view
scripts.repo-stage-approve: aql vault exec --for=npm vxg:pub01 -- npm stage approve
scripts.repo-stage-reject: aql vault exec --for=npm vxg:pub01 -- npm stage reject
